items.description: It’s been a long time coming! We proudly congratulate our campus journalists who qualified for the Division Schools Press Conference 2026–2027, happening on September 5–6, 2026.

Our student writers are taking part in the 2026 District Training Workshop, sharpening their skills in News Writing, Feature Writing, Sports Writing, Cartooning, and Photojournalism. It is a great opportunity for our young journalists to learn, practice, and grow as responsible storytellers who use their talents to inform and inspire.
